_comment: Issue #43, brief F4 (2026-09-22): the DDLI variable list that
re/findings/tuning_checklist_draft.md's *logs* column refers to.
It is the one baseline log to take BEFORE any hardware or calibration
change and again after it, so that tools/logcmp.py can compare them:
python3 logging/med9log.py log --session logging/sessions/tuning_checklist.json \
--bus gs_usb:0 --seconds 300 -o logs/2026-xx-xx_baseline.csv
python3 tools/logcmp.py logs/..._baseline.csv logs/..._after.csv
Every address and scaling below is cited in the `source` field and was
read out of the dump, not out of a tester table.  Two of them are cells
no measuring variable exposes at all - zwdelta_load 0x7FD338 and the
three adaptation channels - which is the whole reason this file exists
next to the VCDS groups.
The checks to apply to each number are in the checklist, not here.
The three most load-bearing:
1. on a fuel change, lam_cmd_b1 must move and fr_w_b1 must stay near
1.0 (32768).  If fr is doing the work, the fuel factor is wrong.
2. dwkrz_1..6 must stay at 0 in steady state after any ignition or
fuel change.
3. prist must track prsoll within a few bar; pump_volume must stay
below VMSVMX = 5000.
NOT simulated: a log taken with logging/ecu_sim.py carries
'# simulated: true' and must never enter a bench comparison set.
description: Issue #43 baseline: the cells the per-modification checklist watches

vars.name: nmot_w
vars.notes: 0.25 rpm/LSB. The u8 copy 0x7FCE95 is measuring id 1 (VCDS 001.1) at 40 rpm/LSB

vars.name: rl_w
vars.notes: 100/4096 %/LSB. The u8 copy 0x7FEF74 is measuring id 2 (VCDS 002.2) and reads about 3.8 % low, see measuring_vars.md section 7.5

vars.name: tmot
vars.notes: measuring id 80 (VCDS 001.2) saturates at 143 degC; this is the raw cell

vars.name: tmst
vars.notes: start temperature, the y axis of KFWKSTT and of mix_801CF5_map

vars.name: rlsol_req
vars.notes: measuring id 375; 32768 counts = 100 % (handler 0x03C348, A = 0x80). Compare against rl_rlsolreq_limit_curve 0x5D9216: 100 % below 4000 rpm, 105 % above

vars.name: rlsol_w
vars.notes: the x input of every KFPRSOL* map

vars.name: misol_w
vars.notes: measuring id 8; 65536 counts = 100 % (handler 0x0391A8, A = 0xFF). misol_w against rlsol_req IS cand_KFMIRL

vars.name: rl_limit_arb
vars.notes: measuring id 2051, the arbitrated charge limit. It falling is how cand_KLRLMXNRED shows up

vars.name: opmode
vars.notes: measuring id 130 (VCDS 051.3 / 068.3), 0..7. Which value is which combustion mode is NOT established - this log is how to find out

vars.name: lam_cmd_b1
vars.notes: measuring id 320. The COMMANDED lambda, computed by lam_ist_from_rk 0x43E164 from rk itself

vars.name: lam_sensor
vars.notes: measuring id 45, the sensor side the controller subtracts

vars.name: fr_w_b1
vars.notes: measuring id 29 (VCDS 001.3), Q15: 32768 = 1.0. MUST stay near 1.0 after a fuel change

vars.name: fr_w_b2
vars.notes: measuring id 28 (VCDS 001.4)

vars.name: frm_w_b1
vars.notes: measuring id 33 (VCDS 032.2). The multiplicative adaptation hides a steady fuel error - watch it drift

vars.name: rk
vars.notes: the relative fuel mass gk_rk publishes; the per-bank copy 0x80303A is measuring id 3

vars.name: ti_sum
vars.notes: measuring id 595 (VCDS 002.3) clamps at 0xFE01 and divides by 255; this is the raw 32-bit sum

vars.name: mixture_running
vars.notes: Q12, 4096 = 1.0. The warm-up enrichment of mix_801CF5_map 0x5D3580 shows up here

vars.name: ksta
vars.notes: 1024 = 1.0, the cranking quantity

vars.name: fgru_trim
vars.notes: Q7, 128 = 1.0. Anything but 1.0 means adaptation channel 10 has been moved

vars.name: adap_ch10_fgru
vars.notes: tester adaptation channel 10, default 128, limits 26..179. NOT a measuring variable

vars.name: adap_ch8_ksta
vars.notes: tester adaptation channel 8, default 128, limits 64..141, multiplies ksta

vars.name: adap_ch4_mixture
vars.notes: tester adaptation channel 4, default 128, limits 64..141, multiplies the running mixture

vars.name: zwgru
vars.notes: the base ignition angle, before zwmin and the knock retard

vars.name: zwdelta_load
vars.notes: NEW in F4 and NOT a measuring variable: zwbas_per_bank adds it to every bank. -6.0 .. +7.5 degCA, zero below 47 % charge

vars.name: dwkrz_1
vars.notes: measuring ids 88-93. MUST be 0 in steady state; the six cylinders are contiguous

vars.name: prist_w
vars.notes: measuring id 500 (VCDS 106.1)

vars.name: prsoll_w
vars.notes: measuring id 501 (VCDS 231.2). Clamped by KLPRMAX 0x5D5546 = 110.0 bar

vars.name: pump_volume
vars.notes: clamped at VMSVMX 0x5D4BC6 = 5000. Log it before and after any rail-pressure change

vars.name: hfm_raw
vars.notes: the raw hot-film signal KFKHFM / KFPU* correct. Watch its peak-to-peak at low speed and full throttle
